remarks: Nestled in Stamford's convenient West Side, this charming Colonial home exudes timeless elegance with classic finishes. Offering 4 spacious bedrooms and 3.5 baths, this home is perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The eat in kitchen flows seamlessly into the sun-filled family dining room and living rooms. The first level is completed with first floor bedroom and en suite. On the second level, the primary suite features a full bath and walk-in closet, 2 additional bedrooms and office space. The third level has a recreation room and or additional office space with full bath. This home offers both tranquility and convenience, with easy access to downtown Stamford, parks, and major highways. A true gem!  Highest and Best: 1-15-25 @noon
